WITH sums AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_prijem,
    SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_vydej
  FROM trans
)
SELECT
  total_prijem,
  total_vydej,
  (total_prijem - total_vydej) AS diff,
  CASE WHEN (total_prijem - total_vydej) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS balanced
FROM sums;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('B','D') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('B','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_count,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('B','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS ratio_of_total_loans
FROM loan;

       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.account_id IN (
  SELECT a.account_id
  FROM account a
  WHERE a.account_id IN (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 1
  )
)
AND c.client_id <> 1;

FROM loan AS l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
  SELECT d.account_id
  FROM disp AS d
  WHERE d.client_id = 1 AND d.type = 'OWNER'
) AND l.account_id IN (
  SELECT d2.account_id
  FROM disp AS d2
  WHERE d2.client_id = 1
) AND l.account_id = 97;

SELECT c.type AS card_type
     , c.issued AS issued_date
FROM card c
WHERE c.disp_id IN (
  SELECT d.disp_id
  FROM disp d
  WHERE d.client_id = 1
    AND d.account_id = 97
    AND d.type = 'DISPONENT'
);
